stem: Triangle DAB is equilateral and inscribed in a circle; the line through B with C on its right is the tangent at B. The angle of tangency ∠ABC equals the inscribed angle on the same arc. Calculate $m(\angle ABC)$: drag A, B and C so the inscribed angle has that same measure.
solution: The tangent-chord angle ∠ABC equals the inscribed angle on the same arc AB, namely ∠D of triangle DAB.
Triangle DAB is equilateral, so each of its angles is 60°.
So $m(\angle ABC) = 60°$; set the inscribed angle to 60°.

hints.text: Think about the angles of an equilateral triangle, then use the inscribed angle on the same arc.
The angle must face the arc that lies between the sides of the angle of tangency.
Start from the equality of the angle of tangency with the inscribed angle on the same arc, then use what you know about the equilateral triangle.
